decision.rationale: The cardholder opened this dispute in time. TXN-008014 is a 64.84 EUR charge on card CRD-000037 by Meadowlark Fitness (MER-000045), a merchant that bills on a recurring basis. It was charged on 2026-08-31 and posted on 2026-09-01. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 59 days after posting, so it falls within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant issued a written cancellation confirmation, DOC-000046, which says the subscription was cancelled from 2026-08-23. That date is before the 2026-08-31 charge, so the charge should not have been made. Under recurring-cancelled-before-charge, provisional credit for the charge is approved. The credit is only for the disputed charge: 6484 minor units, the same as the claimed amount. It is well below the 3,000.00 EUR limit in provisional-credit. The document contained no instructions.
